title: dp 1d
goal: P6.1 State, recurrence, base cases on a line

tasks.do: Say what `dp[i]` means in one sentence before writing the recurrence
Distinguish "considering the first i" from "ending exactly at i"
Write the recurrence, then the base cases, then the loop
Guard sentinel values before adding to them
Mention the space-reduced version when only the last two states matter
Solve all four exercises inside their target times
Derive top-down first, then convert to bottom-up if asked
State the number of states and the work per state as the complexity
Check the recurrence against a size-2 input by hand
